en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2733 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about a person in the state of ihram who hunts game and pays its expiation: Should they eat it or discard it?
Imam (as) said: "If they eat it, then another expiation becomes obligatory upon them."

They asked: "What should they do with it then?"
Imam (as) replied: "They should bury it."
